lines: Spent 2 hours researching high protein
caloric deficit macro balance...
mummy mixed 4 spoons of desi ghee into dal
saying 'bahut kamzor ho gaya hai'
Manager on Friday 6 PM: 'Enjoy weekend
and disconnect completely guys'...
Same manager on Saturday 8 AM: 'Can you
jump on a quick critical sync call?'
'Today I saw an ant carry a breadcrumb
for 10 meters in the rain...'
Here are 7 B2B SaaS leadership lessons
it taught me about compounding hustle
Started a ₹5,000 monthly SIP in high-risk
Small Cap fund for financial freedom...
Nifty dropped 500 points the exact minute
my monthly salary got auto-debited
Bangalore landlord deducting ₹40,000 from
my security deposit for 'air wear-and-tear'
and 'negative spiritual vibes' after I lived
in the room for only 10 months
Told parents that learning coding guarantees
high salary job till retirement...
2 months into the job, manager replaced
our entire department with an AI tool
Blinkit can deliver 3 lemons and ice cubes
to my doorstep in 7 minutes...
but takes me 4 hours of staring at the wall
just to reply to one simple text message
Relatives asking: 'Beta company me kaam
kya karte ho exact batao?'...
Me trying to explain I am Chief Growth
Hacker at a pre-revenue stealth startup
Doctor wrote what looks like an ancient
hieroglyphic curse on the prescription...
Local chemist bhaiya handed me 3 strips of
Paracetamol in 2 seconds without looking
3 AM: 'Kal 5 baje uthunga, 10km run, Rust
language, aur SaaS company khadi karunga'...
8:30 AM: Snoozing 12th alarm while lying
under blanket scrolling meme reels
